title: Associate Quality Engineer
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
We're hiring Associate Quality Engineers to work at Veeva, working on various products in the Life Sciences industry encompassing the fields of pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices.
As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing of software, ensuring customer success with every release.
Graduates or anyone curious about Quality Engineering can apply. Our onboarding program provides a dedicated buddy to guide you through the process, and our collaborative environment is the perfect place to enhance your skills alongside like-minded engineers.
What You'll Do

• Create testing-related documentation, including test plans, test cases/scripts, and bug reports assessing quality and associated risk

• Automate and work closely with the automation group to automate features for better regression coverage

• Triage and/or assist with triaging of automation results

• Develop deep expertise in the product

• Conduct QA tests and verify outcomes within schedules/timelines

• Work with software engineers, product managers, and other QA testers in an Agile team environment

Requirements

• Experience coding in Java AND/OR mobile languages

• Understanding of Software QA methodologies, tools, and approaches (black box and/or automated testing) in a software company with short-release cycles

• Curiosity and ability to quickly learn new technologies

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Must be located in the PST/MST timezone

Nice to Have

• Experience with SQL

• Knowledge of Java, Python, or other object-oriented programming language

• Knowledge of Atlassian products like Jira, Greenhopper, and Clover is an advantage

• Knowledge of modern best practices for software development

• Knowledge of Mobile Testing and Automation -Appium, XCUI, Espresso, KIF

• Knowledge of Mobile Apps Development (Android/iOS)

Interviewing with Veeva

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance

• Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

• Retirement programs

title: Software Engineering, Senior Advisor
description:
Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to fill a role of a Data and Integration Engineer to support the CMS Fraud Prevention System (FPS) Program. The Data and Integration Engineer owns both the one-time integration effort that lands Peraton ’s propriety tool, Rapid FI, inside the FPS operating environment and the ongoing FPS data pipelines that feed Rapid FI. Working with the FPS Innovation Lab team, this role supports the Rapid FI application tier inside the FPS AWS boundary and builds the ingestion, transformation, and delivery layer that pulls data from FPS to power Rapid FI's Medicaid and FDOC user experiences.
Key Responsibilities

• Establish the Rapid FI data-ingestion path from FPS-authoritative sources

• Design, build, and operate the FPS data pipelines feeding Rapid FI; for example, the FPS Medicaid fraud-detection model outputs, provider/beneficiary reference data, claims history, UCM case records, historical enforcement records, and OnePI data.

• Wire Rapid FI into FPS identity, RBAC, audit, and security controls; produce the integration documentation (data-flow diagrams, control mappings) the Regulatory & Compliance Lead and CMS need.

• Run pipelines on the FPS Modeling and Analytics Platform under FPS security and governance controls, and align pipeline design with the planned FTEC data-warehouse consolidation.

• Coordinate with the Rapid FI product team on releases and operational hand-off.

Qualifications

• Minimum of 12 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 10 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 7 years with Ph.D.

• Strong Python and/or Java development, with the other as a working competency; strong SQL.

• Deep AWS core-services experience: VPC, EC2, IAM, KMS, S3, RDS, ECS/EKS, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, CloudWatch.

• Production Kubernetes / EKS experience.

• Solid PostgreSQL experience (RDS operational data) and experience building distributed / big-data pipelines with Spark, Airflow, Kafka, or equivalent.

• Experience wiring applications into an existing identity model (Okta SSO / RBAC) and routing audit logs to CloudWatch and Splunk.

• Experience operating inside a customer ATO boundary or comparable regulated environment (Federal / HIPAA / equivalent).

• US citizen (in US 3 of last 5 years); ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Requirements

• Hands-on Snowflake experience: SQL, warehouses, RBAC, data shares, tasks/streams

• Hands-on Databricks experience: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, notebook and job workloads.

• Experience with GitOps (Argo CD, Helm) and IaC (Terraform); modern CI/CD practice.

• Prior integration of a commercial product into a CMS or Federal-health-agency environment.

• Prior experience with CMS data systems; for example, FPS, IDR, One PI, UCM, T-MSIS.

• Medicare and/or Medicaid claims data experience.

• Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) experience; certification preferred.

• Terragrunt for Terraform module and multi-environment management; service meshes (Istio/Linkerd), Vault or AWS Secrets Manager, zero-trust patterns.

• CMS security frameworks: CFACTS, CSRAP, FISMA/ATO artifact experience.

• Experience with rules engines (ODM/Drools) or rules-based fraud-detection models; job scheduling / process automation (Airflow, Control-M).

title: Entrepreneur in Residence
description:
Category: Business Management

Location:

About Gegidze Group

Gegidze Group is a holding company built out of Tbilisi since 2017. We build and operate companies across three areas: business services, regulated finance, and real assets. Our bet is that the next generation of global companies will be built from places like Georgia, not in spite of being there, but because of what it offers: low tax, senior talent at a fraction of Western cost, and a position between Europe, Asia and the Middle East. We exist to make that practical for founders, and to prove it by doing it ourselves. Everything we sell to clients, we run first. We build companies to hold, not to flip.

Our companies:

• Gegidze- tax, legal, structuring and financing for founders operating from Georgia.

1000+ clients across 50+ countries.

• HelloTeamUp - Employer of Record and remote teams from Georgia and Eastern Europe. Clients include HP, Payoneer, Wizz Air and Lieferando.

• Unitty.io - CRM, automation and AI agents for growing businesses.

• Gegidze AMC- asset management with an umbrella fund: real estate, B2B financing and private equity sub-funds.

• Moneto Pay - payment services for high-risk e-commerce and iGaming.

• Bankysh - consumer wallet and cards. Launching this quarter.

• Digital Jungle - coworking and office space in Tbilisi.

• Urban Rent - construction equipment rental.

The role
I take one or two people a year. Not more.

Here is the deal.

I need people who can sell and build. Not one or the other.

Two ways in

1. You have an idea.

Bring it. If it holds up and you can sell, you get capital, legal, finance, developers, and a brand people already pick up the phone for. You run it. You own a real piece of it.

2. You do not have an idea yet.

Also fine. Work next to me on the existing businesses for 6 to 12 months. Learn how we structure, sell, hire and finance things here. Then take one vertical and run it.

What you will actually do

• Sell. Every day. Outbound, partnerships, conferences, deals.

• Open new markets: UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, Middle East, US.

• Build what you sold.

• Hire the team that delivers it.

• Own the P&L.

What I am looking for

• You have carried a number and hit it.

• You have closed B2B deals yourself, not managed someone who did.

• You move without being told twice.

• You can write a clear email and hold a room with a founder.

• Fluent English. German, Russian or a Nordic language is a real advantage.

What I am not looking for

• Consultants who make decks.

• People who need a job description to know what to do today.

• Anyone who wants to learn entrepreneurship without selling anything.

• Title collectors.

What you get

• [BASE] plus commission on everything you close.

• Equity in the business you build or run.

• The whole group behind you: capital, licences, talent, legal, clients.

• Me, directly. No manager in between.

This is not a safe job. It is the fastest route I know from operator to owner.

If that is you

Message me with two things:

1. The hardest deal you ever closed.

2. What you would build with our infrastructure, or which of our businesses you would want to run.

No CV needed. A paragraph is enough.

Valerian Gegidze

Founder, Gegidze Group

title: Web3 / Full-stack Software Engineer
description:
As our Web3 / Full-stack Software Engineer, you will be designing, developing, and deploying software solutions that power various products at stake.fish. In this role, you will work closely with a group of talented engineers, product managers, and UX designers to build the next generation of staking products. Your work will help with securing a wide range of blockchain networks and contribute to the bedrock of decentralization.
What will you do?

• Build new products & features that meet critical product and business needs.

• Build pixel-perfect and responsive web applications with web3.js, ethers.js, React.js and TypeScript.

• Continuously prototype and improve UIs iteratively with the product and design team.

• Write server code in Python that is extensible, well-tested, and secure.

• Leverage automated testing, CI/CD, container orchestration, and other modern development techniques.

• Collaborate with the team to review PR, and make improvements to the codebase.

What are the requirements?

• You have deep front-end development knowledge and knowledge of React .

• You have experience with web3: blockchain, and smart contracts.

• You are proficient in using web3.js and ethers.js libraries.

• You are knowledgeable with Ethereum and EVM concepts.

• You have a good understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• You have a track record of designing, creating, and maintaining production services.

• Familiar with Linux, cloud services (such as AWS), and Docker.

• Able to work independently and set up an efficient development environment.

• You have basic skills on Unix command line & shell scripting.

What will be great to have?

• You can review EVM-based smart contracts and audit for security issues.

• You are contributing to the open-source community.

• You have working experience in a startup environment.

Why are we awesome you ask?
We are truly at the forefront of the crypto ecosystem as maintainers of the infrastructure layer of blockchain networks! We practice the crypto team mentality by assembling a truly global and diverse team.
We collectively represent more than 12 different countries and are united in a single mission: building out the future of decentralization. Crypto is here to stay, having introduced novel ideas such as DeFi, NFTs and DAOs. At the core of all this are teams like us working relentlessly to build the necessary tools and applications that help run and secure blockchains.
Here are some other reasons you should join us:

• We have employees from over 10 countries across the globe, and you will be able to meet interesting people from different backgrounds and cultures. Distributed and remote work is baked into our culture.

• We are one of the top staking service providers with over $3B of assets staked across our validators. We actively explore and develop new products related to staking. You will work on high-impact engineering projects building exciting new products in a startup environment.

• We have a capable and passionate team. You will find teammates who are power DeFi users, intense NFT collectors, Bitcoin & Ethereum knowledge nerds, etc. You can learn and debate everything on crypto with our teammates.

• We are not backed by VC funding, and we are already profitable. Our financial independence means that we can make decisions independent of VCs, and we prioritize our ideals of decentralization, user sovereignty, and user privacy over simply making a profit. It also means that, unlike most other startups, stakefish can provide you with a stable low-risk employment opportunity without fundraising concerns.

title: Global Transportation Specialist
description:
Job Description Summary
As a member of the Global Transportation team, you will be part of an international organization that drives GE Aerospace ’s transportation and logistics execution across a complex global supply chain. This role supports the business’s Clear to Build strategy by ensuring material flows reliably to meet engine build and delivery requirements. The position will report into the Inbound Control Tower, the team responsible for enabling Clear to Build through disciplined transportation execution, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.
This is a high-intensity, high-volume execution role with primary focus on international and domestic inbound routes into the United States, while supporting a broader global portfolio. Success in this role requires the ability to receive overnight handoffs, assess priorities quickly, structure the day, and drive actions to closure in a dynamic environment.
This role is ideal for someone with hands-on logistics experience, strong judgment, a bias for action, and the communication skills to engage stakeholders across transportation, customs, operations, suppliers, and internal customers. While process improvement is an important part of the role, the core need is consistent operational execution.

Preferred location: Ohio or Kentucky. Candidates located across the Eastern Time Zone may also be considered. Job Description
Roles & Responsibilities

• Execute Clear to Build transportation processes and standard work to transport, track, expedite, and deliver parts in support of engine build requirements.

• Receive, interpret, and prioritize overnight handoffs, converting them into a clear daily execution plan with strong follow-through.

• Manage a high volume of transportation activity and escalations, ensuring urgent issues are addressed with speed, accuracy, and discipline.

• Identify and surface emerging inbound delivery risks, including both international and U.S. domestic shipment issues, and engage the appropriate stakeholders to drive resolution.

• Serve as a transportation escalation point for execution issues affecting material availability, build readiness, and supply chain flow.

• Develop practical logistics solutions to meet urgent or non-standard transportation requirements within a complex regional and global network.

• Maintain a working knowledge of customs-related requirements for international shipments, partnering with customs and transportation teams to support compliant, efficient movement and minimize delays.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

THE ROLE

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

- Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

- Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

- Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

- Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics,

title: Algorithms Engineer, Power Applications
description:
Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid, bringing real-time visibility and power-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.

The Power Applications team takes power orchestration algorithms from idea to production. We develop, ship, and maintain the applications that run on Karman to orchestrate closed-loop control actions and deliver quantifiable customer value. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role. As a Senior Algorithms Engineer, you will develop and deliver these control algorithms, working day to day with the principal engineer who owns our control architecture. You will develop the theory behind our algorithms, validate them against real hardware and realistic workloads, implement them in production code alongside our software engineers, and stay with them in the field, measuring, tuning, and improving them release after release.

Your time will be split between improving the algorithms already in production and R&D for the next iterations of the product, from smarter forecasting and online learning to orchestration across larger portions of a data center and new generations of GPU hardware.

Strong candidates come from many paths. Some lean toward control theory and estimation, others toward building and hardening real-time systems. Both are welcome. What we require is rigor, a systems mindset, and the drive to see your work shipped and owned.

Responsibilities

• Design, analyze, and deliver improvements to the control and orchestration algorithms that allocate and enforce power across servers, racks, and rows at high speed and with hard reliability guarantees

• Own algorithms end to end: theory and prototyping (Python), production implementation (Rust and Python), validation, deployment, and ongoing tuning in the field

• Help to define how we measure algorithm performance, from adherence to electrical limits to impact on compute throughput, and build the benchmark and regression suites that hold each release to that bar

• Continuously improve the performance, robustness, and operability of the algorithm-driven services already in production

• Drive R&D that de-risks and shapes future product iterations (forecasting, automated parameter tuning, orchestration at larger scales, new compute and actuation hardware), running experiments in our lab and pilot environments and turning results into clear decisions

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, physics, mechanical or aerospace engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience

• Deep expertise in control systems and mathematical optimization, including feedback control, state estimation, and the practical realities of latency, noise, and missing data, ideally in distributed or edge settings

• A track record of taking algorithms from concept to production in physical systems, owning their performance once deployed, and designing them to fit the whole system rather than optimizing components in isolation

• Strong Python skills for prototyping and analysis (e.g. pyspark, tensorflow, pytorch) and the ability to work in production codebases in a systems language (we use Rust, and will support you in learning it)

• Comfort in a continuous delivery environment: working directly in production repositories, writing tests, reviewing code, and using field performance data to understand and improve algorithms

• Excellent written communication and the habits of a strong remote teammate: proactive updates, thorough documentation, empathy, and assuming good intent

• Willingness to travel up to 10% of the t

Company Overview
hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.
Job Overview
As a Quantitative Researcher at hermeneutic research, you will develop and improve systematic trading strategies across digital asset markets.
You will work across the full research lifecycle: identifying market inefficiencies, developing hypotheses, analyzing large-scale market data, building predictive signals and trading models, designing robust backtests, and helping to monetise successful research and improve firm-wide execution quality.
This role will be grounded in real market behavior and production trading data. You will work extensively with tick market data, order book and trade data, execution data, and portfolio-level performance to identify market inefficiencies, test hypotheses, and determine whether observed patterns are robust and tradable.
You will join a team with high-frequency/systematic trading and market making background, whose strategies that naturally enable improvement of firm-wide execution quality. You will collaborate closely with traders, quantitative researchers, and engineers while retaining significant ownership of your own research. Successful researchers are expected not only to develop sophisticated models, but also to identify the questions that matter, design rigorous experiments, challenge assumptions, and translate findings into economically meaningful improvements to live trading.
This is an opportunity for a strong quantitative researcher to work in a highly collaborative environment with access to substantial data, technology and trading infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities

• Research, develop and optimize systematic trading strategies and signals across digital asset markets.

• Analyze high-frequency market data, including trades, order books, derivatives data, and cross-venue market activity, to identify exploitable market structure and behavioral patterns.

• Formulate research hypotheses and design statistically rigorous experiments to evaluate them.

• Build robust backtesting and simulation frameworks while carefully accounting for transaction costs, market impact, latency, liquidity, and other real-world trading constraints.

• Research market microstructure, liquidity dynamics, price formation, execution behavior, and short-horizon alpha.

• Develop quantitative models for signal generation, execution, portfolio construction, and risk management.

• Evaluate existing strategies and identify opportunities to improve alpha, execution quality and robustness.

• Work closely with engineers to translate successful research into reliable production trading systems.

• Monitor live strategy performance and investigate discrepancies between research, simulation, and production results.

• Continuously improve research methodologies, datasets, tooling, and experimental standards across the quantitative research process.

Requirements
Must-Haves

• A degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Finance, or another highly quantitative field.

• Strong quantitative and statistical reasoning, with the ability to translate ambiguous market questions into testable hypotheses.

• Strong programming ability, particularly in Python, with experience analyzing large datasets and building quantitative research pipelines.

title: Senior Fullstack Mobile Engineer
description:
ABOUT US:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a seasoned Fullstack Mobile Engineer to help shape the core experience for thousands of restaurant teams. This is a senior role focused on building performant, polished applications across mobile platforms.

You’ll lead development of cross-platform features, collaborate closely with design and product, and contribute to shared backend components when needed. You should bring a strong product mindset, care deeply about developer experience, and be excited about building better software, faster.

This role is ideal for someone who has experience shipping real-world apps, and is looking to make high-impact technical decisions in a fast-moving team.

 

Our Tech Stack: We use Kotlin multiplatform and Jetpack Compose. Everything runs in GCP and our database it’s Postgres.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Work on the development of our app architecture across Android and iOS

- Design and implement shared business logic and client code, as well as platform-specific UI components where needed

- Work closely with designers, PMs, and other engineers to deliver intuitive, delightful product experiences

- Contribute to backend services where necessary, ensuring tight integration and performance across the stack

- Continuously improve build tooling, developer experience, and code quality

- Play a critical role in shaping how Tebi scales across new markets, languages, and user types

 

WHAT YOU BRING:

- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with deep expertise in mobile engineering

- Strong experience building and shipping Android apps; familiarity with iOS and multiplatform development patterns.

- Strong experience with Kotlin

- Comfortable owning architecture decisions and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship features

- A strong product mindset, you care about solving real problems for users, not just writing code

- Great communication skills and a pragmatic approach to building scalable systems

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

 

BENEFITS:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Lunch Provided in Office

- Team building events

- Unlimited time off

Note: Interviews will start after the 14th of September.

 

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

 

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

• Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal.

• Job type: Independent contractor with variable hours based on operational demand. Most RN contractors are expected to support 10-20 hours per week on average, depending on volume and availability.

title: Founding iOS Engineer (m/f/d)
description: About us Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope. The role We're looking for an iOS engineer who loves the camera. Our app turns an iPhone on a microscope into a lab instrument, and the hard problems live on the device: holding focus on a moving sample, running computer vision in real time, and capturing a recording precise enough for a clinical result. On top of that, the app has to be simple enough for a technician in a busy lab. You'll own it end to end, together with the founders. What you'll do Own the app end to end, from architecture to release. Push the iPhone camera and on-device models to their limits, so every recording is good enough to analyse. Design the capture workflow with lab staff, so technicians get it right the first time. Spend time in the lab, measure what works, and decide what to build next. What you bring Camera depth. title: Data Privacy Manager

The Privacy Manager will act as the internal lead for KLDiscovery on data privacy queries, serves as the primary point of contact for data subjects and regulatory authorities, provides expert advice on data protection matters, undertakes implementation of data privacy initiatives, ensures compliance with KLDiscovery policies and supports KLDiscovery in managing risks associated with the processing of personal data for clients and employees.

Compliance Monitoring and Advisory

• Monitor compliance against global data protection laws and internal policies, procedures, and controls, both for clients and employees.

• Advise KLDiscovery and its employees on data protection obligations and best practices.

• Monitor emerging trends, legislative changes, and guidance relating to data privacy, particularly involving use of artificial-intelligence.

Risk and Assessment

• Conduct regular audits, risk assessments, and reviews of data processing activities including vendor due diligence as it relates Data Privacy Assessments.

Records and Documentation

• Develop and maintain data protection policies, privacy notices, and supporting documentation.

Data Subject and Regulatory Liaison

Governance, Training and Awareness

ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

TEAM CONTEXT

The AI Transformation Office (AITO), part of AI Core, is Nubank's central office driving the company-wide AI transformation. We orchestrate all of the AI workstreams - including function transformation, infrastructure, AI risk, AI cost and communications - and work directly with Nubank's management team and senior leaders across the company.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

You join a small core team as the person who brings the outside view: first-hand experience of how an AI plays a key role at a company that is further along. You'll use it to shape where Nubank's transformation goes next, decide which AI solutions we build or buy, and structure how progress reaches the management team - while staying hands-on enough to unblock the initiatives that matter most.

Impact: you will shape the direction, reach and quality of Nubank's AI transformation.

- Shape Nubank's AI strategy with industry learnings. Bring what worked and failed at top players to define where Nubank goes next - what to double down on, what to stop, how to sequence it, and which operating model fits.

- Define our AI solutions portfolio. Map the AI solutions we have internally and support build-vs-buy calls - which tools, harnesses and context layers Nubank should build in-house versus source externally - and shape the scope of the ones we build.

- Own the management team narrative. Structure what goes to Nubank's management team every week - turning signals from every workstream into a clear picture of progress, risks and the decisions needed.

- Define what success looks like. Set ambitious targets for our AI initiatives and the KPIs, measures, and mechanisms that show whether they are actually delivering impact.

- Unblock critical initiatives. When something is stuck, go into the team, understand the blocker and resolve it - across functions, without formal authority.

- Run the operating rhythm. Lead weekly workstream sessions with initiative owners on gaps, ETAs and resourcing; connect cross-workstream dependencies and escalate risks early.

Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.
We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.
As the Patient Customer Experience (CX) Lead, you are accountable for building and leading the discipline within the argenx Patient Strategy & Experience. You will establish how argenx understands, designs, delivers, and continuously improves the end-to-end experience of patients and caregivers across the enterprise portfolio, therapeutica areas, indications, brands, and stages of the patient journey.
You will create the frameworks, methods, standards, and capabilities that enable argenx to translate patient needs, behaviors, and experiences into meaningful experience-related and business decisions. Through end-to-end journey design, voice-of-patient insights, Design Thinking (DT), Human-Centered Design (HCD), co-creation, experimentation, and rapid prototyping, you will identify the moments that matter most and help Patient Marketing and Engagement Strategy, Patient Support Services, Field Clinical Educators, Patient Advocacy, Media, and other cross-functional partners design optimal stakeholder experiences.
As a member of the Patient Strategy & Experience leadership team, you will serve as the senior integrator of CX across communities. You will also connect with CX leaders and capabilities across argenx communities to share insights, build & strengthen repeatable models, and help advance a more connected experience across customer groups. This is a new capability for argenx , requiring a leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, build the discipline from the ground up, and influence leaders across the organization to translate patient insight into measurable improvements in the experience argenx delivers.
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Customer Experience Strategy & Voice of Patient

• Define and lead CX strategy and establish the CX discipline across all argenx patient services and communities.

• Develop and maintain an integrated, portfolio-level understanding of patient and caregiver journeys across disease areas, patient populations, and lifecycle stages.

• Establish repeatable approaches for journey mapping, patient personas, touchpoint and channel assessment, and identification of the moments that matter most across the patient experience.

• Define how patient insight and voice-of-patient inputs are gathered, synthesized, prioritized, and translated into strategic priorities and experience decisions.

• Identify experience opportunities, unmet needs, friction points, and gaps across patient journeys and translate them into clear recommendations for relevant communities and teams.

• Maintain a portfolio-level view of evolving patient needs and experiences, helping leadership determine where focused attention and investment can create the greatest impact.

• Ensure CX strategy remains connected to evolving patient, disease, market, scientific, and portfolio dynamics.

• Codify CX approaches and learnings into scalable frameworks and practices that can support patient-facing teams and, where relevant, inform broader CX efforts across argenx .

Design Thinking, Experience Design & Experimentation

title: Staff Demo Engineer
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Staff Demo Engineer on the Demo Engineering team, you’ll shape the technical tooling and platform behind 1Password’s go-to-market demo experience. You’ll build scalable demo environments, interactive product experiences, and shared infrastructure that help teams communicate 1Password’s value across the customer journey. Your work will help make secure access simpler and support 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future for everyone.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

- Bring substantial experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, technical marketing, DevOps, solutions architecture, or demo engineering.

- Apply experience in cybersecurity, identity, Privileged Access Management (PAM), developer tools, or a related technical domain.

- Build full-stack and automation solutions using technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, React, or Python, with experience designing systems that other engineers can build on.

- Design and operate infrastructure using infrastructure as code, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), containers, and cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

- Understand identity and access management concepts, including single sign-on (SSO), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect (OIDC), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), device trust, passwordless authentication, and passkeys.

- Balance speed, reliability, cost, and security while explaining technical tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

- Create interactive software-as-a-service (SaaS) demos and guided product experiences using platforms such as Reprise, Navattic, Walnut, or Arcade; experience with mobile device management (MDM) tools such as Jamf, live event demos, utilization analysis, artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tooling, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) server

title: Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research http://harvey.ai/research.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

- Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail.

- Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows.

- Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation.

- Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination.

- Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most.

- Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code.

- A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead.

- The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria.

- Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LL

title: Data/ETL Engineer (Senior)
description:

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Data/ETL Engineer to sustain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), develop approved integrations, and maintain reliable data pipelines supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
This position will implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers using SQL, Python, APIs, and incremental loading techniques. The engineer will reconcile data, manage schema changes, maintain lineage, and troubleshoot complex pipeline failures to support accurate and timely mission analysis, AI capabilities, and reporting.
The Senior Data/ETL Engineer will work with the Lead Data/ETL Engineer, database administrators, data governance personnel, AI/ML engineers, BI developers, testers, and Government stakeholders to maintain secure, traceable, and supportable data integrations.
This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.
Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Senior Data/ETL Engineer will:

• Sustain, troubleshoot, and optimize SSIS packages, configurations, schedules, and dependencies.

• Develop and maintain approved integrations between source systems, databases, APIs, analytical environments, and reporting platforms.

• Write SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation routines.

• Develop Python scripts for data ingestion, processing, validation, orchestration, and operational automation.

• Implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers with documented transformation rules.

• Build and maintain incremental loads, including checkpoints and tracking of previously processed data.

• Implement approved corrections and validate successful processing and reconciliation.

• Coordinate changes with database, application, governance, AI/ML, BI, and testing teams.

• Maintain version-controlled code, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks.

• Provide technical status, troubleshooting findings, risks, and improvement recommendations to the technical lead and Government stakeholders.

• Experience implementing incremental data loads.

• Experience troubleshooting complex data pipelines.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Trust & Safety
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Senior Backend Engineer II in the Zen team, you will be responsible for building the systems that help keep counterfeit items off Vinted, while protecting legitimate sellers.

Zen sits in the Trust domain and owns the counterfeit detection problem end to end, not just the tools. We combine rules, machine learning and modern AI to find counterfeit listings, understand where detection falls short and keep improving it. The work has a direct impact on how safe and trustworthy Vinted is for our members, and we're growing our use of AI to make that protection work at Vinted's scale.

We work with Go, Ruby and Python, alongside ML models and LLMs.

In this position, you’ll 

• Design and build the backend services behind counterfeit detection.

• Spot new counterfeiting patterns early and turn them into new detection capabilities.

• Take technical ownership of complex projects, from idea to production, including writing RFCs and making architecture decisions.

• Build AI-driven capabilities, including LLM-based systems, that are reliable, observable and cost-aware.

• Collaborate with data and decision scientists, using data to make decisions and bringing engineering input to how detection and models are improved.

• Measure the impact of what we ship, with accuracy and fairness to legitimate sellers in mind.

• Raise the bar for engineering and agentic development by mentoring engineers in the team and beyond.

About you 

• Proven experience designing, building and operating ML- and data-driven backend systems in production, with Go, Ruby or Python, including event-driven systems.

• Curiosity and drive to explore and apply AI to counterfeit detection, staying on top of the latest developments in LLMs and their practical applications.

• Solid understanding of data, ML and LLMs: how models are trained, evaluated and retrained, and how to build reliable systems around them.

• Comfortable working with data and decision scientists, using data to make decisions and contributing valuable engineering input.

• Demonstrated ability to own complex, ambiguous problems end to end and drive technical decisions.

• Pragmatic about trade-offs between catching abuse and protecting legitimate sellers, and able to explain technical decisions to non-engineers.

• Bonus: experience with BigQuery, Vespa, Temporal

Collaborates with Project Manager, Safety/Pharmacovigilance (PvG), Data Management, Biostatistics, QA, Principal Investigator and Sub-investigators, Site Coordinators, the Data Monitoring Committee (DMC), and any other group that directly or indirectly protects the safety of study participants.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Clinical Trial Medical Oversight: Provide medical, scientific, and safety oversight for clinical trials, ensuring protocol adherence, participant safety, eligibility, IP dosing, and management of AEs/SAEs/SUSARs, with 24/7 coverage and backup support as needed.
Safety Review & Risk Management: Lead and support ongoing safety data review, including medical coding, patient narratives, Risk Management Plans, MedWatch reporting, and collaboration with Safety/PvG, DMCs, and cross‑functional teams.
Site & Investigator Support: Serve as the primary medical point of contact for investigators, site staff, and sponsors; participate in site selection, SIVs, investigator meetings, site visits, and protocol deviation and root‑cause assessments.

Trial Design & Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Provide medical input into protocol development and amendments, clinical development plans, study reports, and scientific presentations, working closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, and other departments.
Training, Mentorship & Representation: Train and mentor staff on therapeutic area and clinical research principles, support proposals and commercial activities as needed, and represent the organization at professional meetings.
Qualifications:

• Doctorate degree in medicine or Doctor of Psychology (Psy.D), preferrably with specialization in a CNS therapeutic area. Active license preferred but not required.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Business Development (BD) team, within Anduril’s Growth organisation , is responsible for identifying, shaping, capturing, and growing new opportunities and capabilities for the company. In order to meet current and future client needs, the team must deeply understand the users pain points, how current solutions fail to address existing gaps, and how Anduril products can deliver more effective mission outcomes. BD team members serve as the bridge between clients and the broader Anduril team; they convey client perspectives to other teams across the enterprise while also serving as the Anduril brand ambassador externally. They partner extensively with Anduril Business Lines and Operations teams to ensure that Anduril products exceed client expectations and mission demands, and to drive continuous product improvements in response to ever-changing client needs and operating environments.

This does not simply include expanding upon current work, but also leveraging existing partnerships to explore new areas of work or opportunities by sustaining and building upon the strong foundation of those client relationships.

The team must trust your value judgement and assessment of the required mission outcome as you interpret and convey various client needs. Internally, you will provide the necessary clarity to inform priorities, keep Anduril stakeholders informed, determine key milestones, and proactively providing clear communications to appropriate levels of the company. Your assessment of clients’ needs will inform new product decisions, and your ongoing engagement with clients will yield crucial input that helps Anduril ensure our product suite is best-in-class.

• Ability to travel to meet with customers and support activities.

• Develop and manage operating and capital budgets while ensuring responsible stewardship of resources.

title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Your Role

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

- Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

- Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

- Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

- Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

- Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

- Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

- Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

- Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

- Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

- A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

- 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

- Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

- Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

- Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

- Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

- Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

- Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

- Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

- Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage

- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions

What We Offer

- The opportunity to work on defect inspection for an integrated graphene photonics process flow

- A cleanroom-based role with close collaboration across process, equipment and integration teams

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key-we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

- Briefing senior legal and business leaders on complex regulatory topics in clear, concise and commercially useful terms.

- Acting as a generalist legal business partner for new businesses in Latin America, coordinating a holistic legal approach, including support on agreements related to our products.

- Qualified as a lawyer, holding the local bar license in the country where you will be based.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

You will own accounting memos and policies, lead auditor discussions on the areas you own, and build the controls and documentation that let a young, global company report with confidence.

title: Site Manager
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. The fleet you run will draw more power than some countries, on the way to 10s of GW.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Sites come online in pieces, and you keep the live ones running flawlessly while construction continues around them.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. No prior operations org has run at this speed and scale, so the standards you set become the standard.

ROLE SCOPE

- Lead 24/7/365 operation of all critical infrastructure at your site: electrical distribution (UPS, generators, switchgear), mechanical and liquid cooling, fire/life safety, and building controls, accountable for availability against customer SLAs.

- Own site safety in partnership with HSE, including hazardous energy control, electrical safety, and LOTO discipline across a mixed employee and contractor workforce.

- Build and lead the full site team, facility operators alongside hardware and network operators, owning shift coverage, on-call rotations, performance, and development.

- Run the hardware and network repair operation: own the ticket queues, drive triage, prioritization, break-fix, and RMA workflows, and hold time-to-repair against customer commitments as the fleet scales.

- Run incident and change management for the site: lead severity response as the escalation point, deliver root cause analyses on 5 and 10 day clocks, and drive corrective actions that fix classes of problems, not instances.

- Partner with construction, commissioning, colo providers, and utilities while the site is live and still being built, driving operational readiness, MOP and SOO rigor, and clean handover into operations.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You've run 24/7 critical facility operations where availability was contractual, and you can walk through the incidents that tested it.

- You know electrical and mechanical infrastructure deeply enough to dig into the details with your technicians: you've stood in front of switchgear or a CDU and known which questions to ask.
